resources.string: The live countdown while you rest between sets.
Rings when your rest is over.

Aven reads your watch through Health Connect (steps, workouts, heart rate, sleep and its stages, calories, distance, body numbers) so they show beside your training and the Coach can take them into account. With reading in the background allowed, it reads every half hour so Aven opens up to date.

If you allow it, Aven also writes your weigh-ins and each day's food totals (calories, protein, carbs, fat) into Health Connect when you tap Sync now, so your other health apps see them. Nothing else is written.

The numbers never leave your phone: they go straight into Aven's own page on this phone. Aven has no account and no server that sees them.

You can turn this off in Aven (Settings → Watch) or take the access back in Health Connect at any time.
